people.name: Adah
people.line: Hittite wife of Esau; mother of Eliphaz

people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Reuel
people.line: Son of Esau and Basemath, a chief of Edom

translations.web: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.
translations.bsb: And Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, Basemath gave birth to Reuel,
translations.kjv: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;
translations.asv: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Basemath bare Reuel;
